original_question: How much does it cost to get a copy of my Transcript of Records?
source_document_name_and_version: Laguna State Polytechnic University Citizen's Charter 2026, 1st Edition (PDF created 2026-03-31 +08:00)
exact_supporting_passage: Service title PDF 12: Issuance of Transcript of Records/Transfer Credentials/Certifications/CAV/Authenticated Documents. Office: Registrar. Who may avail: All (Walk-In students & Graduates). FEES TO BE PAID PDF 13: Transcript of Records — Undergrad students P75.00/page; Graduate students P150/page. Certifications P30.00/page (Copy of Grades, F137, CAV, Certificate of Transfer, General Weighted Ave., Subject description, SPES, Permit to Study). Authentication heading on PDF 13 continues PDF 14 P30.00/page. 2nd copy of Diploma P100.00. TOTAL: Depends on the document.

relevant_fee_rows.item: Certifications (Copy of Grades, F137, CAV, Certificate of Transfer, GWA, Subject description, SPES, Permit to Study)

ocr_vs_visual.chroma_mashed_fees: Undergraduate: P75.00/page; Graduate: P150/page; P30.00/page; P137; Second copy of diploma: P100.00
ocr_vs_visual.visual_correction: P137 is OCR of Form F137 under Certifications, not a fee. TOR heading groups P75.00/page and P150/page.

proposed_reference_answer_from_pending_d: The Citizen's Charter 2026 1st Edition service 'Issuance of Transcript of Records/Transfer Credentials/Certifications/CAV/Authenticated Documents' (Registrar, page 12) lists these fees: Undergraduate P75.00/page; Graduate P150/page; P30.00/page; P137; Second copy of diploma P100.00. A human must confirm on the PDF which of those lines is the Transcript of Records fee.
evidence_supporting_proposed_answer: Service exists; Registrar; P75.00/page and P150/page appear on the fee table.
evidence_not_supporting_as_written: Does not isolate TOR. Treats P30.00/page, P137, and diploma P100.00 as possible TOR fees. P137 is an OCR error. Fee table is PDF 13-14 not page 12.
ambiguities_conflicts_missing: Does not check later BOR supersession
recommended_revised_reference_answer_NOT: The Citizen's Charter 2026, 1st Edition, service “Issuance of Transcript of Records/Transfer Credentials/Certifications/CAV/Authenticated Documents” (Registrar) lists Transcript of Records at P75.00/page for undergraduate students and P150/page for graduate students. Those TOR amounts are separate from Certifications at P30.00/page (Copy of Grades, F137, CAV, Certificate of Transfer, GWA, Subject description, SPES, Permit to Study), Authentication at P30.00/page, and a 2nd copy of Diploma at P100.00.
questions_to_resolve_before_approving: Accept visual grouping: TOR = undergrad P75.00/page and graduate P150/page?
Student-facing answer both rates, or undergraduate only unless graduate is named?
Omit non-TOR fees from the TOR gold answer?
Confirm P137 must not appear in gold?
Cite Chroma page 12, PDF 13-14, or printed 5-6?
